title: ProjectGameCredentialAdapter
responsibility: Read a game-specific provider key only from the selected project ignored regular credential file.

inputs.name: ProjectGameCredentialAdapter.constructor.root
inputs.description: Selected local project directory for Git-ignore and regular-file checks.

inputs.name: ProjectGameCredentialAdapter.read.name
inputs.description: Dedicated game-provider key name; ambient credentials and other projects are never used.

outputs.name: ProjectGameCredentialAdapter.read
outputs.description: Key read only from this project ignored regular credential file.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Reports ignored-file or regular-file violations explicitly; missing keys, unreadable files and Git failures require project configuration.
